services.name: Winthrop Fireworks Cruise on Adirondack
services.desc: Winthrop Fireworks Cruise Aboard Schooner Adirondack III Don't want to deal with all the traffic, crowds, and hype surrounding the 4th of July, but still want to celebrate and enjoy the patriotic holiday? Step aboard the Adirondack III for a cruise to Winthrop to watch the fireworks and then sail back to Boston at the end. Enjoy a complimentary drink of any kind with your purchase! This 3-hour cruise/sail/fireworks event offers guests the opportunity to soak up Winthrop's fireworks display from an elegant and relaxing vantage point out on the water. The Adirondack III is a brilliant 80-foot 3 to 3.5 hours

services.name: Gloucester Schooner Fest Fireworks
services.desc: Evening 90-minute sail aboard the classic schooner Adirondack III to watch the Gloucester Schooner Festival fireworks from the water. 1.5 Hour Sail

services.name: Adirondack Sunset Sail in Gloucester
services.desc: Sunset Sail on Schooner Adirondack Embark on a captivating 2-hour Boston Harbor sunset sail aboard our sister ships, the Adirondack 2 and 3, elegantly styled 80-foot pilot schooners. As the sun descends below the horizon, witness the city's waterfront landmarks bathed in the golden hues of twilight. Renowned as the fastest and most elegant schooners in Boston Harbor, the Adirondacks promise a smooth and gentle sailing experience complemented by exceptional customer service from our captain and crew. Relax and unwind with your loved ones aboard our stellar vessels, enjoying the comfort and 2 hour Sail

Gentle and classic pre-recorded music is played to set a relaxing tone for you and your guests. services.name: Boston Harbor Cruise on Northern Lights
services.desc: Step aboard the Northern Lights for an immersive 60 or 90-minute sightseeing adventure across Boston Harbor. Explore the harbor's rich and fascinating history, guaranteed to captivate your attention throughout the journey. Take in the sights from the comfort of our cozy main cabin, complete with heating or air conditioning for your comfort. Alternatively, venture outside to our open-air covered top deck to bask in the fresh sea breeze and marvel at the harbor's beauty. While aboard, satisfy your cravings with a selection of drinks and small bites Up to $44.52 · 1 or 1.5 hour Cruise

services.name: Adirondack III 90-Minute Mimosa Day Sail
services.desc: 90 Minute Day Sail aboard Schooner Adirondack III Our classic 90-minute afternoon day sails are the perfect way to see the sights of Boston Harbor. There is no better way to enjoy the day than sailing aboard the schooner Adirondack III, which is the most elegant sailing excursion you will find in the harbor. Adirondack III is a classically styled 80-foot pilot schooner with long sleek lines. She is smooth and gentle sailing vessel with some speediness to boot.
